newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Sun Hung Kai upgrades Mondragon.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sun Hung Kai upgrades Mondragon.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities Inc said on Monday it has upgraded its rating on leisure and retail firm Mondragon International Philippines Inc to a buy from the previous hold.
"We have changed our recommendation to a buy as sales (of golf shares) picked up," the securities firm said in a report.
The hold rating came after Mondragon sold only 27 shares in the four months ending July, as against 150 in the first quarter of the year.
Sun Hung Kai said the reservations for the golf shares had been piling up in the past weeks.

Mondragon is also scheduled to open a casino on Thursday at its Mimosa hotel and golf course, at the Clark development zone north of Manila, bolstering Sun Hung Kai's bullishness on the issue, the report said.
